description: Searches live one-way flights from the traveller's airport and airports within 300 km to their destination on one date, ordered by earliest arrival, with price in EUR, stops, ground distance to the alternative airport and rail operator links for trips under 1,200 km. Returns 10 options per page; times are local to each airport. Nothing is booked.

date.description: Travel date, ISO 8601, for example 2026-10-02. From today up to 365 days ahead.

destination.description: IATA airport or city code of the destination, for example LON.

include_nearby_airports.description: Also search from the two nearest airports within 300 km. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Options per page, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

origin.description: IATA code of the airport where the traveller is now, for example BTS.

name: sos_find_alternatives
title: Find alternative flights
